note: Precise runs before and after the Peninsula freeways were added to the road assignment (server/beta3/pipeline/peninsula-runs.ts), each against a run of today’s network made the same way in the same process. Hours a weekday; vehicles by period. The "before" runs used the checkpoint’s road base, made from an earlier baseline than its own, so their control (no change) does not reproduce today exactly; their parts are best read against the control’s. aonSeconds: processor seconds for one all-or-nothing loading of the morning’s trips, without and with the freeways.
